QuestInfo.name: Bringing Back the Brain
QuestInfo.0: Ask the Memory Keeper about the Amnesiac Temple Keeper.
QuestInfo.1: The Memory Keeper said that the only way to restore lost memories is to go back to that point in time.\r\nReturn to the Amnesiac Temple Keeper see if he really has forgotten everything.
QuestInfo.2: The Amnesiac Temple Keeper doesn't even remember his own name. Is there really no way to retrieve his memories?

0.0: The memories that the Amnesiac Temple Keeper lost are... innocent memories from his childhood. They defined who he was... If you want to help him get them back, the only way is to go back to those times.
0.1: He must retrieve the memories on his own...

yes.0: No one can help him with his problem... he alone holds the secret...

no.0: Don't overlook the power that the past holds over the present.

1.0: The Temple Keeper told me you'd help me get my memories back! How did it go?

yes.0: I guess... I have to do this on my own. I only wish I knew where to start. Thank you for trying to help...

npc.0: I do hope he gets his memories back...
